t: We review Diveproof's Waterproof Log Book
s: September 30, 2022 - When it arrived and I looked at the contents I genuinely felt like this logbook had been tailor made for me. Aesthetically, it’s beautiful. Simple white background, black writing; with watercolour style pictures in a variety of blues & greens. Of course functionality is the most important feature, but why not write in something you love to look at as well? All essential pages are included; personal information, qualification details, equipment checklist, a bucket list page, a slip-page to put your dive certification cards, and even a map of the world.
